keyFindings.description: The registry opens once at start and again only after a NATS connection event. Any failed open (a JetStream timeout or a slow first CreateKeyValue, not only a missing grant) leaves /v1/legion/agents* at 503 on a listener that reports healthy, until something bounces its connection; a grant applied by config reload never reconnects. The ERROR line and the 503 always say the grant is missing. Round 1's log.Fatal at least retried through a restart. Fix: retry the open in the background with backoff while there is no store, and word the log and the 503 as 'could not open the bucket (a missing grant is the usual cause): <err>'.

readmit() reconnects after a reopen, but notifySynced calls sync.firstSync(readOnly) once (announced guard), so pending-sync keeps readOnly=true from the closed admission: edits on the reopened document show 'can't be sent: this document is read-only', and IndexedDB rows are not restored until a reload. Re-run firstSync(false) when a later admission turns read-write, without firing onSynced again.

With the claim-first order, a write that ends between its claim and its index keys makes Get answer replaced_by null (the session reads as the current holder) or the role key's old entry instead of the session key it just read. Replace this session's sibling with the session-key entry before succession(), which removes the fallback.
